RateLimiter.luau.description: Implements a token-bucket rate limiter. Tokens refill continuously according to a monotonic clock and are consumed explicitly by callers. Public entry points include `RateLimiter.new`, `RateLimiter.GetCapacity`, `RateLimiter.GetRefillRate`, `RateLimiter.GetAvailableTokens`, `RateLimiter.TryConsume`, `RateLimiter.GetRetryAfter`, `RateLimiter.AddTokens`, `RateLimiter.Reset`.
